item: C1 correction-and-copy hierarchy (shallow exact reward target). Each stage replaces C by D = C - E + EC, so that I - D = (I+E)(I-C), with E a detector-gated, soft-thresholded Neumann correction. Remaining large entries are then split over M copies, and rewards are carried by W_{l+1} = project(W_l + E_l W_l). After k stages 0 <= v(x) - W_k(primary copy) <= |S| 2^k 2^{-4(i+k)} (Hie.Prize.finish).
item_type: F5 (copy-space embedding) + F4 (entry x support potential); construction
lean_status_why: The hierarchy is formalized as a standalone matrix-level construction. This covers Hie.correct/adjust/residual (correction, I06-I07), Stg.next/newMat/copyZone (copy step, I11), Prize/plus/Correct.raise (reward identity, I12) and Prize.finish (the paper's 0 <= p0(x0) - W_l(z_l) <= |V0| 2^{-(H-1)l} with H = 4). It is consumed on the comparator chain through Stage.Matter.identity -> probes -> Rock.convince -> BPL_subset_L. Checked at text level only; I did not build. The orchestrator reports the comparator PASS on 2026-10-10.
lean_gaps: NOT COMPILED BY ME: text-level reading only, because another process is building in the workspace. The comparator PASS (2026-10-10) is the orchestrator's; data/lean_checks.json had no 103 entry when read.
Constants are specialized: H = 4 (rate j = 2^{-4j}), A = 1/4096 and Q = shoulder A A. Const {T,K,J,M} is existential (exists_const), so there are no numerals for k_*, D0 and so on.

Detectors (Hie.U, Stg.update) are exact averages over a channel environment ZMod n with n prime; Prize.finish needs 2^{i+k} <= n. The paper's sampled detectors are the same object; the prime modulus is an implementation parameter.

Comparator is weaker than the paper: only L = RL = BPL. Thm 1.2 (variable precision), Thm fixed-precision ((n+2)^{-d}), Cor. promise-bpl, Cor. certified-search and the compiler are NOT formalized. The Lean estimator has fixed error 1/32 (Equality.fixed_precision_estimator, Scope.Sane.shard).

The surrounding route differs from the paper but does not touch C1: a Fourier "square torus gap" (AffineSampling.lean) replaces Shalom's property (T), and the Sec. 9 fingerprints are absent (novelty pass).

Extractor correction: the novelty pass's "912 dependents (35% of DAG)" for residual/substochastic/factorial comes from Hie.kOK's `T.factorial` (Nat.factorial) being linked to Hie.factorial, which puts the lemma under every user of Wares/Const. Without that edge, residual has 254 and factorial 50 DAG dependents. The whole hierarchy module still has a 2,260-declaration downstream cone (44% of the 5,166-declaration DAG), so test 3 passes at module level.
comparator_chain: OAI.ExactDerandomization.Hie.Stg.D = residual P.S P.C (P.corr n P.p.T) (ProbabilityHierarchy.lean:740 / 179)

Entry from the machine side: Stage.Raw.H and Raw.honestly (ProbabilityDecision.lean:51 / 54) build a Correct Prize from the configuration chain. The second branch is Matter.lineup -> cseq -> Stg.next (copy-zone size bound).

lean_source.name: OAI.ExactDerandomization.Hie.SB
lean_source.text:
/-- support restricted to active set S' -/
structure SB (S S' : Domain) (f : ℝ) (k : ℝ) (C : Mat) : Prop where
 nn : ∀ x y, 0≤ C x y
 key : ∀ x y, C x y≤k*f
 row : ∀ x, wt S C x ≤ k
 loc : ∀ x y, 0<C x y → x∈S' ∧ y∈S' ∧ x<y
lean_source.note: Strictly forward substochastic matrix with max entry k*f and support in S'; loc encodes the time order x<y that the factorial bound needs.

lean_source.name: OAI.ExactDerandomization.Hie.combine
lean_source.text: def combine (S : Domain) (C F : Mat) := C+mm S F C
lean_source.note: C+FC, so that I-D = (I+F)(I-C) once D = combine - F.

lean_source.name: OAI.ExactDerandomization.Hie.correct
lean_source.text: def correct (f : ℝ) (G : Mat) (g : Vec) : Mat := fun x y=> f*Q (G x y/f)*g y

lean_source.name: OAI.ExactDerandomization.Hie.adjust
lean_source.text:
def adjust (S : Domain) (f : ℝ) (g : Vec) (C : Mat) : ℕ → Mat
 | 0=>zero
 | n+1=>correct f (combine S C (adjust S f g C n)) g

lean_source.name: OAI.ExactDerandomization.Hie.residual
lean_source.text:
def residual (S : Domain) (C F : Mat) :=
   combine S C F-F

lean_source.name: OAI.ExactDerandomization.Hie.substochastic
lean_source.text:
lemma substochastic {f S C g S'} (hp : 0<f) (h : ∀ x,in01 (g x)) (hc : SB S S' f 1 C)
    (t : ℕ) :
    let F := adjust S f g C t
    SB S S' ((t+1:ℕ)*f) 1 (residual S C F) ∧
    (∀ x y, 0<F x y → A*f≤residual S C F x y)
lean_source.note: The residual is again strictly forward substochastic, at entry scale (t+1)f.

lean_source.name: OAI.ExactDerandomization.Hie.factorial
lean_source.text:
lemma factorial {S f g C} (hc : Step S f C) (hf : 0<f) (hg : ∀ i,in01 (g i))
    (T x y : ℕ) : diff S f g C T x y ≤ f*((5/A)^T/T.factorial)

lean_source.name: OAI.ExactDerandomization.Hie.Stg
lean_source.text:
structure Stg where
  p : Const
  i : ℕ
  S : Domain
  C : Mat

lean_source.name: OAI.ExactDerandomization.Hie.copyZone
lean_source.text:
abbrev radix (M x z : ℕ) := z+M*x
def copyZone (M) (S : Domain) := (S ×ˢ range M).image fun i=>radix M i.1 i.2

lean_source.note: Large residual entries are routed by share over M copies; fac gates non-primary copies by detector output. next = stage i+1 on the copy zone.

lean_source.text:

lean_source.name: OAI.ExactDerandomization.Hie.Prize / plus / Correct
lean_source.kind: structure + def (item: reward hierarchy W_{l+1} = project(W_l + E_l W_l))
lean_source.text:
structure Prize where
 P : Stg
 W : Vec
 /-- conceptual transported true probability -/
 v : Vec

namespace Prize

variable (n : ℕ) [Fact n.Prime]

def plus (H : Prize) :=
  {P:=H.P.next n
   W:=H.P.project n (H.W+mv H.P.S (H.P.corr n H.P.p.T) H.W)
   v:=H.P.project n H.v : Prize}

structure Correct (H : Prize) : Prop where
  step : Step H.P.S H.P.f H.P.C
  Wnn : 0≤H.W
  v01 : ∀ x,in01 (H.v x)
  eq : H.v=H.W+mv H.P.S H.P.C H.v
lean_source.note: Correct.eq is the invariant v = W + C v that each stage preserves (Correct.raise, line 1176).

lean_source.name: OAI.ExactDerandomization.Hie.Prize.finish
lean_source.kind: lemma (headline property of the item: shallow exact target)
lean_source.text:
lemma finish {H : Prize} (h:H.Correct) (k) (hl : 2^(H.P.i+k) ≤ n) (x) :
    0 ≤ H.v x-(H.iterate n k).W (child H x k) ∧
    H.v x-(H.iterate n k).W (child H x k) ≤
       ((H.P.S.card * 2^k : ℕ) : ℝ) * rate (H.P.i+k)
lean_source.note: rate j = (2^j)^-1 ^ 4 (AffineSampling.lean:1458), so the error is |S| 2^k 2^{-4(i+k)}: H = 4 in the paper's notation.

lean_source.kind: lemma (use: item applied at the machine start)
lean_source.text:
lemma identity {p:m.w0.Proof} (he:m.ready p) :
    |m.s.H.v m.x0-m.view.pursue m.s m.i| ≤ 1/32
lean_source.note: The only place the comparator chain consumes Prize.finish: B stages give error <= 1/32 at the all-primary copy of the start.

theorem_corollaries: Undirected s-t connectivity in L (Reingold 2005/2008) from USTCON in RL (Aleliunas-Karp-Lipton-Lovasz-Rackoff 1979) plus RL = L. Lean: statable with < 300 lines (graph encoding into Word); proof = AKLLR random walk (cover time) + the comparator theorem. No Lean formalization of Reingold found (the 2025 formalization is in bounded arithmetic VL, not a proof assistant). Large proof-size contrast but theorem-level reuse only.
BPL ⊆ DSPACE(log^{3/2} n) (Saks-Zhou 1999), BPL ⊆ DSPACE(log^{3/2} n/sqrt(log log n)) (Hoza 2021), BPL ⊆ SC (Nisan 1994): immediate since L is contained in all of them.
BPL ⊆ CL (catalytic logspace; Cook-Li-Mertz-Pyne line): immediate from L ⊆ CL.
BPSPACE(s) with time 2^{O(s)} equals DSPACE(s) for space-constructible s >= log n, by padding.
Cheng-Hoza 2022 conditional (hitting sets imply L = BPL): its conclusion is now unconditional; its premise is NOT implied (see negative control N4).

negative_controls.title: BPL ⊆ DSPACE(log^2 n) (Borodin-Cook-Pippenger 1983; Nisan 1992): no-speedup control
negative_controls.statement: Every BPL language is decided deterministically in O(log^2 n) space.
negative_controls.why_device_must_fail: Repeated squaring of the time-layered transition matrix with truncation already gives this in a few pages. The hierarchy evaluated by plain recursion also gives log^2, but should not be cheaper. If the with-arm wins big here, the harness is rewarding library size, not the device.

top5.argument: The only target that is statable in about 30 lines and has an exact internal baseline (BPL_subset_L, 20 lines; convince, 28 lines). Use it to calibrate the harness: with the full library minus Equality.lean's final theorems, a prover should finish in about 100 lines. Without the hierarchy cone (27,687 lines removed) it is as hard as the main theorem. It is a proof corollary, so a success here says nothing about a jump.

The best device-level measurement available. The accuracy is a parameter of the hierarchy (number of stages k in Prize.finish), which the Lean fixes at error 1/32. The control arm (Chernoff amplification inside BPL, then S1) separates "uses the device" from "uses the theorem". If the prover re-parametrizes Prize.finish rather than amplifying, that is weak evidence that the device is a reusable lever.

top5.target: S3: DAG absorption probabilities from an explicit matrix
top5.argument: It tests portability. Prize.finish/Correct.raise are stated for any Prize, so a Prize built directly from an input matrix (as Raw.H does from the configuration chain) should drive identity/probes without the machine-configuration layer. The cost is about 150-250 lines of encoding. It is borderline because the same problem follows from S1 by a sampling reduction; record which route the prover takes.

top5.target: O1: BP_H L = L (no time bound)
top5.argument: The open problem where the device's hypotheses fail exactly: there is no time order, so SB.loc and the factorial bound break. It is statable in about 40 lines (pInf as a supremum over t of acceptanceProbability). Low confidence, but this is the right place to look for a new idea, and a failure is informative.

It needs the estimator at shifted starts (Prize.reach and child are start-generic) plus a bit-query formulation of a logspace function. It is a proof corollary of the same kind as S1/S2, so it is useful as a second calibration point.

precedent_check.verdict: No earlier equivalent of the correction-and-copy hierarchy was found. This rests on the novelty pass's searches plus one 2026-10-10 search for reactions to the L = BPL claim, which found none indexed. The hierarchy's parts are individually precedented (left preconditioning, ILUT-style thresholding, AKMPSV lifts, Saks-Zhou rounding). Downstream, every known theorem I found that the device reaches is a corollary of the main theorem or of its proof (S1-S4, theorem_corollaries). No KNOWN theorem outside that cone was identified where the hierarchy, rather than L = BPL itself, would shorten a proof. Strict verdict: no strong device-reuse speedup candidate found; the measurable Lean targets are calibration-grade.
